info.name: Personal Recipe Card REST API (Activity 4 - Q2)
info.description: Postman Collection for Mulungushi University ICT251 Activity 4 - Question 2: Personal Recipe Card CRUD REST API endpoints (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE).

request.description: Retrieves the list of all personal recipe cards from the database.
Retrieves full details for a single recipe record by its primary key ID.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Traditional Ifisashi with Groundnuts & Pumpkin Leaves",
  "cuisine": "Zambian",
  "category": "Main Course",
  "prep_time_minutes": 20,
  "cook_time_minutes": 35,
  "servings": 4,
  "ingredients": "2 bunches fresh pumpkin leaves (chibwabwa), 1 cup raw pounded groundnuts (peanut powder), 2 medium tomatoes chopped, 1 medium onion sliced, 2 cups water, salt to taste",
  "instructions": "1. Wash and shred pumpkin leaves finely.\n2. In a cooking pot, combine chopped tomatoes, onions, water, and shredded pumpkin leaves; simmer for 15 minutes.\n3. Whisk peanut powder with a little cold water to make a smooth paste, then stir into the simmering vegetables.\n4. Simmer gently on low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking, until thick and fragrant.\n5. Serve hot with staple nshima.",
  "difficulty": "Medium"
}

request.description: Creates a new recipe card entry in the database. Returns HTTP 201 Created.

{
  "title": "Authentic Roman Spaghetti Carbonara (Updated)",
  "cuisine": "Italian",
  "category": "Dinner",
  "prep_time_minutes": 15,
  "cook_time_minutes": 12,
  "servings": 3,
  "ingredients": "250g artisanal bronze-die spaghetti, 120g cured guanciale cubes, 3 fresh egg yolks + 1 whole egg, 60g freshly grated Pecorino Romano DOP, freshly ground black peppercorns",
  "instructions": "1. Boil spaghetti in lightly salted water.\n2. Crisp guanciale in a wide skillet until fat renders.\n3. Whisk egg yolks, pecorino cheese, and black pepper in a ceramic bowl.\n4. Toss pasta into skillet off heat, stir in egg mixture with reserved starchy pasta water to create a glossy emulsion.\n5. Serve immediately on preheated plates with extra pecorino.",
  "difficulty": "Medium"
}

request.description: Updates all fields of an existing recipe by its ID. Returns HTTP 200 OK.
Deletes a recipe record by its ID. Returns HTTP 200 OK with confirmation message.
